email.subject1: a signal play for Osa Commerce
email.body1:
Aaron, saw Osa Commerce launch AI-Powered Retail Compliance at Manifest, aimed at that $5B chargeback problem.

Launching net-new into retail and CPG usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Osa off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Aaron, quick follow-up for Osa Commerce.

Bringing a new compliance product to retail and CPG, the pipeline target usually outpaces what the team can cover. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Osa needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Aaron, last bit of proof for Osa Commerce.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Osa's reply rate likely compares to other supply-chain tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Aaron, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling retail and CPG pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A fresh product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your retail motion? I will tailor it to Osa either way.
